observation.command: echo '=== POST bogus login (expect graceful failure, NOT 500) ==='; curl -s -o /tmp/login_resp.html -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' -d 'user=bogus_user&pass=bogus_pass' http://127.0.0.1:32789/login; echo '---response markers---'; grep -oiE '(Ungültig|ungültig|falsch|error|Error|Fehler|Passwort|Anmeldung|<title>[^<]*)' /tmp/login_resp.html | sort -u | head -20
